binary_policy: Native PNGs were generated under /tmp and are intentionally not committed. Reproduce them before any independent image judgement; an absent PNG is NOT_RUN, never numeric evidence.

reproduction.browser: Playwright-installed Chromium, one 1920x1080 DPR-1 browser, HUD disabled, clear weather, noon

sources.role: RI-CAM07 canonical player back source; also feeds the distinct S46 derived windows
RI-CAM07 canonical player front source; also feeds the distinct S46 derived windows

cam07_b1.definition: For each source, player ID-mask bounding box expanded on every side by 5% of character height; L=floor_pow2(min of both expanded widths and heights), L>=256; same relative centre; native pixels; no clip, resize, or pad.
cam07_b1.reason: The capture API did not emit an ID mask. The old whole-frame 1024-square B1_prime result is explicitly rejected and is not substituted.

vis03_m5_character_closeup.definition: A separate native 1024x1024 square centred on the player centroid in each 1920x1080 source; background retained; no resampling.
vis03_m5_character_closeup.aggregation: minimum/worst source; both sources fail HFR and alpha
vis03_m5_character_closeup.note: This absolute VIS03 row cannot stand in for CAM07 B1 parity.
